gloss: major technique; big move; bold feat

definitions.gloss: major technique; big move; powerful maneuver
definitions.explanation: A large, impressive, or difficult technique in martial arts, sports, or performance. Also used figuratively for bold, dramatic actions.

examples.japanese: {大技|おおわざ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
{大技|おおわざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{出|だ}して→繰り出す：13882_kuridasu⟧⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}→逆転：06839_gyakuten⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They pulled off a major move and turned things around.

examples.japanese: {大技|おおわざ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伴|ともな}う→伴う：10389_tomonau⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{成功|せいこう}すれば→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{形勢|けいせい}→形勢：16342_keisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: Big moves carry great risk if they fail, but if they succeed, they can change the situation in an instant.

notes:
USAGE:
Originating from martial arts and sumo, now widely used in sports commentary and figuratively for bold actions. Contrasts with ⟦{小技|こわざ}→小技：21809_kowaza⟧ (small technique, subtle move).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大技|おおわざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{出|だ}す→繰り出す：13882_kuridasu⟧ (to pull off a big move)
- {大技|おおわざ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧ (a big move lands/succeeds)
- {大技|おおわざ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑|いど}む→挑む：12708_idomu⟧ (to attempt a major technique)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{小技|こわざ}→小技：21809_kowaza⟧: small technique, subtle move — the opposite
- {必殺技|ひっさつわざ}: finishing move, killer technique — implies a decisive blow
